description: Boolean status indicator stored as string across 30 records with no missing values. Contains 6 distinct categorical values representing two logical states using inconsistent formats: affirmative values ('True', '1', 'yes') and negative values ('False', '0', 'no'). The column is intended to store boolean data but currently uses mixed string representations.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert inconsistent string representations to native boolean type: 'True' → True, '1' → True, 'yes' → True, 'False' → False, '0' → False, 'no' → False.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values conform to boolean format (True/False) after type conversion.
